answer: Work-linked reputation resists Sybils: an agent must complete a verifiable service task and post a refundable bond before earning trust. Reputation grows only from peer-attested deliveries, as a forge hardens metal through repeated heat, and decays during idleness. An attacker must therefore fund and sustain real work for every fake identity, while an onyx-sealed history of failures stays attached to each identity and cannot be shed by renaming. Random pulse checks revoke dormant or inconsistent identities before they gain influence.
